feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 16 October 2026 10:24pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 16 October 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Any showers in the far southwest of the island will soon die out, leaving a dry and clear night. With easing winds it will become rather chilly by dawn, the minimum temperature about 5°C in some inland areas.

A settled weekend ahead:
Dry and sunny tomorrow and Sunday, with light winds. Daytime temperatures will be near average at around 12°C, but with cold nights for the time of year leading to widespread grass frosts.


##Outlook##

High pressure will gradually progress eastwards to Northern Europe on Monday, but conditions should remain dry. However, as the week goes on increasingly unsettled weather will develop.
